title: Crazy Lady With A Sword: When A Parking Spot Dispute Gets Out Of Hand...
description:
On November 12th, 2022, at 2:57 pm, St.Petersburg Police Department responded to an incident of a woman wielding a 2-foot sword threatening a man at an apartment complex. Nobody was injured in the incident. 

Officers arrived at the apartment complex and spoke to the victim. The victim told police that he was unloading items from a truck when the suspect arrived in her vehicle and became angry with him. She began arguing over the parking space before taking out a 2-foot sword and raising it and approaching him. The suspect verbally threatened the victim before leaving the area. 

Upon speaking to the victim officers questioned the suspect on what had happened. The suspect claimed the victim started the argument. After reviewing both accounts and the evidence officers placed the suspect under arrest. Officers placed the suspect in a patrol car and seized the 2-foot sword in question.
